panels.title: VFS handling time · mean / min / max
VFS handling time · mean / min / max

options.content:
All procedures, backends and workers combined within each VFS pool. Exact mean, minimum and maximum of completed request durations in the latest reporter interval (normally 5 s). Empty intervals are gaps. Includes success and error responses; excludes queue wait, serialization and network delivery. Unit: seconds (auto-scaled).

**Metrics:** `nfs_vfs_request_duration_seconds_mean` · `nfs_vfs_request_duration_seconds_min` · `nfs_vfs_request_duration_seconds_max`

panels.title: VFS queue wait · overall p95 and worker spread
VFS queue wait · overall p95 and worker spread

options.content:
Overall: p95 of the combined queue-wait histogram over 5 min. Spread: largest worker p95 minus smallest worker p95 in the same window. Workers with no observed waits are excluded from the spread; an empty pool has a gap. Unit: seconds (auto-scaled).

**Metric:** `nfs_vfs_queue_wait_duration_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance, job, run, runtime, pool) (rate(nfs_vfs_queue_wait_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
